queries.fighters: SELECT fighter_id, full_name, source_url, dob FROM fighters WHERE fighter_id::text = ANY(%s) ORDER BY fighter_id
queries.fights: SELECT f.*, e.event_date, e.event_name FROM fights f JOIN events e USING(event_id) WHERE f.fight_id::text = ANY(%s) ORDER BY f.fight_id
queries.predictions: SELECT * FROM predictions WHERE fight_id::text = ANY(%s) ORDER BY fight_id, scored_at
queries.reviews: SELECT * FROM reviewed_prediction_fights WHERE fight_id::text = ANY(%s) ORDER BY fight_id, reviewed_at
